integrity: General statements follow by a constructive character-support proof and subgroup Möbius inversion; 17 small finite-group/alphabet systems independently exhaustively checked by standalone standard-library Python verifier (349 count identities). Finite tests are not infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Finite abelian group, finite alphabet \(q\ge2\), active neighborhood equal to the group, one active pattern; no claim for nonabelian groups, partial neighborhoods or compositions. Bibliographic priority under other terminology is not independently established.
title: Exact symmetry-transition census for full-memory lazy cellular automata
